worst.comment:
/**
 * Moves the cursor to the end of the word to the right of the current position using fast navigation.
 * Use it for standard rightward word movement.
 */
worst.why: claims 'fast navigation'; the code uses WordNavigationType.WordEnd (text copied from CursorWordLeft)

worst.comment:
/**
 * Moves the cursor to the end of the word to the right and expands the selection using fast
 * navigation. Use it to select the word to the right.
 */
worst.why: claims 'fast navigation'; the code uses WordNavigationType.WordEnd (copied from CursorWordLeftSelect)

worst.comment:
/**
 * Creates an observable value that informs observers when the value changes. Use this when you need a
 * settable observable with an initial value and an optional name or owner.
 */
worst.why: says the name/owner is optional; this overload takes a required owner (the optional-name form is the other overload)

worst.comment:
/**
 * A command that moves the cursor to the left within a word. Use it to implement leftward word
 * navigation.
 */
worst.why: says it moves 'within a word'; it is the base class for moving left by word boundaries

worst.comment:
/**
 * A command that moves the cursor to the right within a word. Use it to implement rightward word
 * navigation.
 */
worst.why: says it moves 'within a word'; it is the base class for moving right by word boundaries
